data.name: OutboxReceiverTitle
data.value: Message sent outside the unit of work's transaction

data.name: OutboxReceiverMessage
data.value: This call commits on its own while unit of work '{0}' is in scope; call it through '{1}' so the message commits with the unit

data.name: OutboxReceiverDescription
data.value: IBus and IQueue never join a transaction, so a message they send goes out even when the unit's work rolls back, and the unit's work can commit while the send is lost. The unit's outbox writes the message inside the unit's transaction. Keep the autonomous call only for a message that must go out even if the unit rolls back.
